Hey Annett. My name is Isabella, and I have to make a sudden move to Brisbane on Sunday. I work in film and have a 4-month contract beginning Monday (they work fast, aha). I am looking for something that can help me unwind a little. I am very social and adore the outdoors. So when I am not working, I love hanging out with friends or climbing a mountain/visiting a waterfall. I am interested in both rooms.
Hope to hear from you soon.
Warmest,
Isabella
